messages:
alex.m: Hey security team — BlueHaven Financial sent over a long security questionnaire (SIG/CAIQ style). Can someone take this? We're in POC and need answers to share with their InfoSec by EOD Tuesday. Link: https://files.example.com/bluehaven-sig.pdf :eyes:

samira.s: assigning to me. I'll open a vendor risk ticket and map the SIG rows to our control docs. ETA 24-36h for an initial pass, sooner for high-risk items.

kevin.ops: tagging the infra folks — if they ask about VPC/on-prem deployment we can note Redwood Private + KMS/HSM options. Also confirm SOC2 + ISO27001 status.

sec_bot: Created ticket VR-2345 for BlueHaven Financial (priority: P1). Attachments saved to /sec/vr/VR-2345.

alex.m: thanks. two quick items BlueHaven called out explicitly: 1) Data classification & PII handling 2) Ability to keep inference logs in-customer-control for 12 months. They want a yes/no + short explanation.

samira.s: for data classification: we need the sales contact to confirm what data will be sent during POC (sample prompts). If it includes PII, we should recommend Dedicated or Private with customer-managed KMS. For logs retention: we support configurable retention; default telemetry is 30 days but we can offer 12-month retention as an add-on for Private/Dedicated.

jane_pds: FYI BlueHaven's security team also asked about model provenance and quantization — they want to know if we're using any third-party weights and how we validate them.

samira.s: note for the SIG mapping: I'll flag the following as high attention items: encryption at rest (customer KMS), key rotation, access logs, pen test cadence, and model provenance.

kevin.ops: quick snippet we can paste to them: ```Encryption: Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256. For Private/Dedicated deployments we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM). In transit: TLS 1.2+.```

alex.m: perfect. Can we also confirm SLA for POC? They asked about 99.9% latency SLOs — we're flexible but need to avoid promising dedicated SLAs for a free trial.

samira.s: I'll call that out: for POC we'll propose best-effort performance; committed SLOs are part of Dedicated contracts. I'll add language to the questionnaire.

alex.m: any blockers on answering the CAIQ sections about vulnerability management and secure SDLC?

samira.s: vuln mgmt — we run quarterly scans + ad-hoc for critical findings, monthly dependency scanning. Secure SDLC — tracked in engineering docs and PR policies; can provide attestation and link to SOC2 controls.

kevin.ops: ops note — for model caching/kv security, we should include that KV caches are ephemeral per-instance and not persisted to customer buckets unless configured.

samira.s: @alex.m can you confirm the POC timeline + whether they'll push any real customer data? That changes the recommended deployment and required legal addendums.

alex.m: I'll confirm POC dates (looking like 30 days starting next Monday) and will ask them to classify test data. Also asking Product to prepare a short architecture diagram to attach.

samira.s: great. I'll upload a first-pass SIG response to VR-2345 in ~6-8 hours. If anything looks risky I'll escalate to @kevin.ops. :thumbsup: 

alex.m: thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll update BlueHaven with the interim timeline and attach the infra snippet.

sec_bot: Ticket VR-2345 updated: assignee=samira.s, status=in-progress, due=1893543189.
